bearingSource: OSM way 132404249 long axis 59.3°; the street front (+Z, raised central risalit) faces SE (149.3°) onto Bd. Ferdinand I, which runs along the SE side of the outline (OSM road geometry, aerial view).
approximations: OSM outline is a plain 34.6 × 27.7 m rectangle; the U-shaped plan (front wing ≈ 14.5 m deep, rear wings ≈ 12.5 m wide, small rear courtyard) is interpreted from the stepped roof corner in photos 01/06/07/10/12 and a coarse aerial view. Heights estimated from window sizes (eave ≈ 10.6 m, risalit eave ≈ 12.5 m, main ridge ≈ 17.2 m; pitches 42°, end hips 50°). Courtyard elevations and rear-wing ends are not photographed (window rhythm repeated); fretwork valance, lettering of the frieze, archivolts and mouldings simplified; dormer count per roof face estimated.

note.ro: Machetă interpretată după fotografiile de referință; planul în formă de U (aripile posterioare și curtea), înălțimile și fațadele dinspre curte sunt aproximate, iar ornamentația și inscripția frizei sunt simplificate.
note.hu: A referenciafotók alapján értelmezett makett; az U alakú alaprajz (hátsó szárnyak és udvar), a magasságok és az udvari homlokzatok közelítők, a díszítés és a fríz felirata egyszerűsített.
note.en: Scale model interpreted from the reference photographs; the U-shaped plan (rear wings and courtyard), the heights and the courtyard elevations are approximated, and the ornament and frieze lettering are simplified.
